              <p>Jowat SE with headquarters in Detmold is one of the world’s leading suppliers of industrial adhesives. <p>The company was founded in 1919 and has manufacturing sites in Germany in Detmold and Elsteraue, plus four other producing subsidiaries, Jowat Corporation in the USA, Jowat Swiss AG, Jowat Manufacturing in Malaysia, and Jowat China Adhesives Co. Ltd. </p>
<p>The supplier of all adhesive groups is manufacturing 100,000 tonnes of adhesives per year, with 1,400 employees. </p>
<p>A global location structure with 27 organisations plus partner companies is guaranteeing local service with close customer contact.</p>
